text:
Maria (marketing): Quick sync — we want to publish the release post tomorrow morning. final ask: changelog link, docs link, and confirmation of a 2-hour embargo window. who can lock things down?
Aaron (eng): I can take the freeze. planning to cut the release at 07:30 PT, freeze PRs at 07:00 PT. changelog is in the PR I just pushed. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/482 :memo:
Maria (marketing): perfect. can you paste the static changelog URL we should include in the post? need exact path for the blog CMS.
Aaron (eng): use this one (stable): https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/2026-03-23-release — it's generated from the PR after we merge.
Jess (docs): docs site is live with the new API examples. final doc page: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/new-routing. I left a small note about the batching example under "Performance tips".
Maria (marketing): awesome, will slot those. is there anything in docs that should be redacted for public release?
Jess (docs): no redactions. one internal note left in the draft, i removed it and updated the page.
Oliver (product): webinar slide deck needs a short blurb about the canary timing + expected latency numbers. Aaron can we get a 1-2 line summary?
Aaron (eng): sure — canary will run in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for 2 hours, expect p95 latency ~85ms on the benchmark harness (on dedicated-8). I'll put the exact phrasing here in a minute.
Lisa (marketing): inbound routing question — can we add a UTM to the docs link so leads from the blog go to the right funnel? also need the webinar registration link to be in the first paragraph.
Maria (marketing): yes add UTM. final links for post: changelog (stable), docs (with utm_campaign=release_march), webinar reg (https://redwood.ai/webinar/register). i'll assemble copy once i have final phrasing.
Aaron (eng): phrasing for ops section: "Canary rollout begins at merge time, staged to us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for 2 hours. Expected p95 token latency: ~85ms on Dedicated-8; fallback to smaller variant if capacity is constrained." feel free to edit.
Maria (marketing): perfect — short enough for the blog. can someone confirm deploy scheduling?
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @aaron for 2026-03-23 07:30 PT to staging and canary clusters. CI: passed. :rocket:
Aaron (eng): confirmed. i'll lock the branch and tag after merge. tagging as v2026.03.23.
Maria (marketing): thanks. last thing — embargo window: public post at 10:00 PT, embargo lift at 10:00 PT, internal grooming complete by 09:45 PT. please no posts or demos before 10:00 PT. @everyone :eyes: :+1:
Oliver (product): noted. i'll tell the partner contacts to hold until 10:00 PT.
Lisa (marketing): i'll schedule the social blasts for 10:05 PT.
Maria (marketing): great. i'll publish the blog and send final assets to comms at 09:50 PT for a quick look. any other blockers?
Aaron (eng): none from eng. good to go on my side.
Jess (docs): docs live and stable. good to go.
Maria (marketing): thanks team — i'll post the final draft here 30m before publish for a quick QA.
Maria (marketing): (added after) blog CMS note — use preview slug: /release/march-2026-inference. make sure the canonical points to docs.redwood.ai.
Lisa (marketing): copied. running preflight checklist now.
